about: #4628: each surviving det-port mutant stated `equivalent` or `unreachable`, with the Java change and why it cannot alter observable behaviour; proposed in a PR, reviewed by the owner. A run that kills a stated mutant fails (the claim was wrong). Ids are mutation.py's; before / after are the Java line.

verdicts.equivalent: the change cannot alter anything the program shows (output, screen, files, COMMAREA, abend)
verdicts.unreachable: no input of the program reaches the changed code
verdicts.harness-gap: the change alters behaviour the proof runs but does not compare (open: the harness must)
verdicts.case-gap: an input the case lacks would kill it (open: strengthen the case)

caWhole() restore runs only for an exactCommarea task; no scenario sets commarea_length, so the bytes beyond EIBCALEN are never restored/compared. Add a scenario with commarea_length 100 ending in SEND/RETURN.
Initial ZEROS of WS-CURR-BAL: COBIL00C only reads it at line 194 (MOVE WS-CURR-BAL TO CURBALI) straight after MOVE ACCT-CURR-BAL TO WS-CURR-BAL at 193, and never as part of WS-VARIABLES.

The byte[] COMMAREA path (calen = cx(task, cb.length)) is never used: the harness passes a typed DTO and no scenario has a link area. Harness cannot express it, so strengthen the harness/case with a raw byte COMMAREA.

COR on the exactCommarea cut: only a scenario with commarea_length (exact, calen<length) versus a normal one tells && from ||; add commarea_length 100 and compare the returned COMMAREA bytes beyond EIBCALEN.
The copyOf(caWhole, calen) cut makes an over-read past EIBCALEN raise PastFrom; no scenario has commarea_length, so none notices it missing. Add commarea_length 100.
The caWhole==null test in the IndexOutOfBounds catch only matters for an exactCommarea over-read; no scenario has commarea_length, so it never runs. Add commarea_length 100.
handleLink is the entry point for a LINK to COBIL00C; no CardDemo program LINKs it (a terminal transaction, CB00), and the proof enters it by handleTransaction
perform() scan over performThru for a nested PERFORM THRU exit: translator paragraph-machinery guard; COBIL00C's flow never reaches the reversed loop with a live entry (same as precedent).
perform() performThru[d]==i check of the paragraph-exit scan; guard not reachable differently by any input of COBIL00C (same as the cbsa-updcust perform-scan guards).
perform() 'next >= 16' guard: COBIL00C has fewer than 16 paragraphs, so no input reaches next >= 16.
EVALUATE CONFIRMI WHEN 'N' OR 'n': the lowercase 'n' compare is never true in the case. Add a scenario with receive CONFIRMI 'n' (decline, screen cleared and no payment) to kill it.

INITIALIZE TRAN-RECORD: every field it initializes is moved to right after (TRAN-ID, TYPE-CD, CAT-CD, SOURCE, DESC, AMT, CARD-NUM, MERCHANT-ID / NAME / CITY / ZIP, ORIG-TS, PROC-TS) before the WRITE; this one is TRAN-SOURCE's, which MOVE 'POS TERM' TO TRAN-SOURCE rewrites whole

`CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM = LOW-VALUES AND = SPACES` for OR: every caller of RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN moves a program name into CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM first ('COSGN00C', CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM when it is not blank, else 'COMEN01C'), so it is neither, and both conditions are false

the failed XCTL in RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN: negated, the task skips condition() and goes on to MAIN-PARA's RETURN instead of abending. A PF3 scenario whose XCTL fails with PGMIDERR kills it on the det port, but the committed model port RETURNs instead of abending there (tried in this PR, left out until the model port is fixed: #4648)
EIBRESP2 store: COBIL00C never references EIBRESP2 (it uses RESP/RESP2 into WS-RESP-CD/WS-REAS-CD), and DFHEIBLK is not compared.
CICS command exit 'to >= 0' test of a HANDLE CONDITION/ABEND GO TO target: COBIL00C has none (all commands use RESP), so 'to' is always negative.
inside `if (0 != 0)`: SEND MAP has no RESP and the translator writes its response as the constant 0, so the block never runs
